interfaces.name: Figma design editor (GUI)
interfaces.technology: Web app and macOS/Windows desktop app
interfaces.classification_rationale: Actions are expressed by manipulating presented affordances (canvas, panels, menus) over a persistent, navigable representation of file state; web and desktop share one contract.

provenance.evidence: First-party desktop clients for macOS and Windows plus the web app.
Desktop app provides the same features and functionality as the browser editor.

interfaces.name: Figma mobile app
interfaces.classification_rationale: A touch-oriented client for viewing, commenting, playing prototypes, and mirroring; actions are expressed by manipulating on-screen affordances of file state.

provenance.evidence: Official mobile app: access Figma Design/Make/Slides/FigJam files, comment, play prototypes, mirror designs.

interfaces.name: REST API
interfaces.technology: HTTPS REST API, base https://api.figma.com, PAT/OAuth2
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes provider-defined operations over files, comments, variables, components, and dev resources via structured HTTP requests.

provenance.evidence: REST API for accessing files, components, variables, comments; PAT/OAuth2; base https://api.figma.com.

interfaces.name: Plugin API
interfaces.classification_rationale: Plugins invoke provider-defined imperative operations against the open document's scene graph; primitive is the explicit operation call.

provenance.evidence: Editor extensions that read and write the open file via a JavaScript API.

interfaces.name: Widget API
interfaces.classification_rationale: Explicit invocation of provider-defined operations/components with a declarative, state-synced contract distinct from the imperative Plugin API; still Operation Invocation.

provenance.evidence: Interactive on-canvas widgets built with a React-like declarative API and synced multiplayer state.

interfaces.name: Code Connect CLI
interfaces.classification_rationale: A first-party CLI whose own command contract publishes component-to-code mappings; the consumer invokes provider-defined commands.

provenance.evidence: Code Connect CLI maps and publishes code components to design components; distinct command surface from REST.

interfaces.name: Webhooks V2
interfaces.technology: Provider-initiated HTTP callbacks to a subscriber endpoint
interfaces.classification_rationale: The service initiates delivery when subscribed events fire on files, projects, or teams, to a consumer-controlled receiver URL.

provenance.evidence: Subscribe to real-time events for files, projects, and teams; payloads delivered to a registered endpoint.

interfaces.name: Figma MCP Server
interfaces.technology: Model Context Protocol server (remote hosted and local desktop)
interfaces.classification_rationale: A standardized interface exposing semantically described, discoverable and selectable tools (get_design_context, get_metadata, get_variable_defs, write-to-canvas); discovery/selection is part of the contract.

provenance.evidence: MCP server as a standardized interface for AI agents to interact with Figma, with discoverable tools; remote and local hosting.

interfaces.name: Figma Make
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer expresses actions through natural-language messages ('through conversation') interpreted by the service; tool orchestration is internal, so Conversational rather than Agentic.

provenance.evidence: AI-driven prompt-to-app tool; 'through conversation you can ideate, iterate, and improve'; interface centers on an AI chat.

access_mechanism_ledger.detail: Figma design editor (GUI) — same contract as web
Code Connect CLI; no persistent navigable TUI documented, so no Interactive interface from the terminal
Feature accessed through the web editor's affordances, not a separate interaction contract
Figma MCP Server (one interface across both hosts)
Embedded viewer is the web Interactive interface via iframe; Embed Kit/Embed API are SDKs
Website-publishing feature within the editor, not a distinct access mechanism
Third-party integration supporting Code Connect UI
Background localhost helper with no interface; supports the desktop app

access_mechanism_ledger.mechanism: FigJam / Figma Slides / Figma Draw / Dev Mode / Figma AI features
access_mechanism_ledger.detail: Products and modes surfaced within the Interactive editor, not separate contracts
